description: ESTNeT (Event-driven Space-Terrestrial Network Testbed) is provided by ESTNet project. ESTNeT provides an extensible satellite and terrestrial network simulation environment built on OMNeT++. Its components model satellite and ground communication together with orbital and spacecraft-related behaviour. Geographic context: global (software applicability). Temporal coverage and spatial resolution are not established beyond the source details stated here. Source code and documentation are linked through the public repository; no software was installed or executed. The cited material was readable without payment. The reviewed metadata does not establish validation for a particular constellation. Potential simulation use: Study satellite-terrestrial networking and the effect of spacecraft constraints on service.
